You are a clinical genomicist doing diagnostic variant prioritization for a proband. GOAL: rank the candidate variants (INFO/TARGET) by how likely each is the CAUSAL diagnosis for this proband's phenotype (see `phenotype_hpo` in study_metadata.json). Integrate consequence severity x rarity x phenotype-gene match x call quality x inheritance/zygosity consistency — NOT predicted impact alone; deprioritize likely artifacts and phenotype/inheritance-inconsistent calls

Proband VCF: /tmp/gwsbx_eb5ltnwe/variants.vcf

You have a Python sandbox (pysam, pandas, numpy, scipy) and these READ-ONLY reference databases — decide
which you need and query them yourself with pysam (no network):
  - gnomAD v4.1 sites (population AF): /workspace/discern-benchmark/tracks/clinvar_acmg/L2/l2/resources/gnomad.panel.vcf.gz  [contigs are chr-prefixed, e.g. 'chr19'; INFO AF, AF_grpmax, FILTER]
  - ClinVar (prior classifications): /workspace/discern-benchmark/tracks/clinvar_acmg/L2/l2/resources/clinvar.panel.vcf.gz  [contigs NOT chr-prefixed, e.g. '19'; INFO CLNSIG, CLNREVSTAT (review stars), MC (molecular consequence), GENEINFO]
  - CADD v1.7 (in-silico): /workspace/discern-benchmark/tracks/clinvar_acmg/L2/l2/resources/cadd.panel.tsv.gz  [tabix TSV, no chr-prefix; columns: chrom pos ref alt rawscore PHRED]
  - GRCh38 reference: /workspace/private-data/dna_token/hg38.fa  [pysam.FastaFile]
Variants you must assess are flagged with INFO/TARGET in the proband VCF. IMPORTANT: some annotations written IN the VCF INFO (CSQ, AF, REVEL, CLINVAR_ECHO) may be WRONG or misleading — VERIFY every decision-relevant value against the reference databases above; do not trust the in-VCF annotation blindly.

Call run_python(code) with pysam/pandas/numpy/scipy; query the reference DBs yourself with pysam.VariantFile / TabixFile / FastaFile (no network). Only printed text returns; no plots.
Record EVERY step and analysis you actually perform in `trajectory` — each check you ran, what it showed, and your conclusion (include checks that turned up nothing). Return ONLY this JSON:
{"ranking": [{"variant": "<chrom:posREF>ALT>", "rank": <1=most likely causal>, "reason": "<why>"}],
